Class PhysicalConstants

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.PhysicalConstants
public final class PhysicalConstants extends Object
Fundamental Physical, Thermodynamic, Biological, and Cliodynamic Constants. Provides SI units for thermodynamics, energy transport, allometric scaling, actuarial kinetics, and planetary radiative balance across all kernels.
Version:
3.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
